_comment: Deterministic FSMA 204 exemption rules (21 CFR 1.1305 / 1.1300). Reviewable data, not code. The engine evaluates a customer's claimed exemptions against these; it NEVER auto-suppresses CTE/KDE checks on a claim — a partial/full exemption is surfaced for human confirmation. Conservative: a claim without supporting evidence is 'not_determined', never 'not_exempt'.

exemptions.evidence_required: average annual produce sales records establishing eligibility (e.g. below the regulatory threshold)
exemptions.decision_note: A qualifying small producer is fully exempt for the food it grows; eligibility must be evidenced.

exemptions.evidence_required: records showing direct sale to consumers
exemptions.decision_note: Food sold by a farm directly to consumers is exempt.

exemptions.evidence_required: kill-step / processing records showing the food was changed so it is no longer a listed food
exemptions.decision_note: If a kill step or change removes the food from the FTL, downstream FTL obligations may not apply, but receipt and kill-step records must still be kept.

exemptions.evidence_required: confirmation the commodity is on the FDA rarely-consumed-raw list
exemptions.decision_note: Produce that is rarely consumed raw is exempt.

exemptions.evidence_required: product identification showing the food is not on the Food Traceability List
exemptions.decision_note: A food that is not on the FTL is out of scope for these records (not an exemption, a scope determination).
Foods regulated by USDA (certain meat, poultry, egg products) are exempt.

exemptions.evidence_required: confirmation the entity acts only as a transporter of the food
entity classification as an RFE or restaurant
exemptions.decision_note: Retail food establishments and restaurants have modified requirements (partial).

exemptions.evidence_required: confirmation of fishing-vessel status before first land-based receiving
exemptions.decision_note: Fishing vessels are partially exempt prior to first land-based receiving.
